title: The Prototype Archive

body:
This is **sample content** included to demonstrate the portfolio layout. Replace it with a real project in Pages CMS.

## What a project page can include

- The problem or idea behind the work
- Screenshots and key decisions
- Features, progress and future plans

You can add any number of projects, with individual pages generated automatically.
